title: mut.channel_lomas_cellular_morphogenesis
mutation_directive: Andy Lomas — Cellular Forms — Cellular Forms (Lumen Prize Gold 2014); ongoing 'Morphogenetic Creations'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Coral- and brain-like organic surfaces grown from millions of cells: rumpled lobes, branching folds, cauliflower convolutions in matte bone-white or pale pink against black void. Monochrome, sculptural, biological — like deep-sea calcium organisms photographed under raking light. TECHNICAL HOOKS for three.js / GLSL: Particles = cells linked by springs to ~6 neighbors; each cell splits when accumulated 'nutrient' exceeds threshold; new cells inserted into the mesh, neighbor links rewired. Render as instanced spheres or a marching-cubes/SDF skin over the point set. GLSL: ambient-occlusion-cheap shading via depth-derivative; subsurface tint. Motion: split/relax loop runs in compute shader; the form grows over the visit. WHY DIVERSE: Pool has zero topology-changing growth — Lucy is a static cloud, L-systems branch but don't subdivide a surface, differential growth is 2D-curve-only. This adds 3D surface morphogenesis: a form that is structurally evolving its own mesh. Stay faithful to the visual signature; pick whatever three.js primitives are needed (Lines2 / InstancedMesh / SphereGeometry / custom ShaderMaterial) — but the FORM should read as if this artist made it. REF: https://andylomas.com/
